# Events

Every step of a turn is one event. This is the complete list of kinds the engine can emit, the box each lands on, and the card that explains it. A test fails if a kind is added without a card.

An event is a JSON object: `seq`, `t_ms`, `kind`, `stage` (the box), `src` (the box the data came from), `title`, `detail`, `status` (`ok`, `skip`, `warn`, `blocked`, `error`), `span` (`main` or `sub:N` for a worker), `dur_ms` and `data`. A trace file is one header line, one line per event, and one footer line.
